title: Telangana’s SR University and Malla Reddy University published 2026 B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture admission routes
description: Compare the 2026 B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture admission routes, fees and ICAR accreditation records for SR University (Warangal) and Malla Reddy University (Hyderabad).
summary: SR University in Warangal and Malla Reddy University in Hyderabad represent Telangana’s two ICAR-accredited private universities in the research set, offering distinct campus settings and direct/entrance admission pathways.

sections.heading: Comparing Warangal and Hyderabad private agriculture options
paragraphs: In Telangana, two private universities appear in the audited ICAR List II register for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture: [SR University](/university/sr-university) at Ananthasagar in Hanumakonda (Warangal) and [Malla Reddy University](/university/malla-reddy-university) at Maisammaguda in Hyderabad.

Both institutions publish dedicated School of Agriculture pages outlining four-year Honours curricula, instructional farm training, and semester/annual fee structures separate from PJTSAU state convenor counselling.

sections.heading: Fee period, hostel charges and subject eligibility checks
paragraphs: Applicants comparing SR University and Malla Reddy University should verify whether quoted tuition figures are per semester or per year, confirm compulsory admission and examination fees, and review practical field-plot access using [reading an agriculture fee letter before paying](/blogs/reading-an-agriculture-fee-letter) and [RAWE and experiential learning](/articles/rawe-and-experiential-learning).

faqs.question: Are SR University and Malla Reddy University affiliated with PJTSAU?
faqs.answer: No. Both are state-enacted private universities in Telangana with their own degree-awarding authority and ICAR-accredited School of Agriculture units.

faqs.question: Can MPC (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) students apply for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at these universities?
faqs.answer: Check each university’s current eligibility table on its admission-process tab to confirm whether both BiPC and MPC streams are accepted for the intended intake.
